Search summary: 64 km of pistes (17.2 km easy, 35.1 km intermediate, 11.7 km difficult — percentages derived from these km); 21 lifts up to 3,250 m: 6 gondolas, 6 chairlifts (1 double, 1 triple, 1 quad, 3 six-seat) and 9 surface lifts (including 7 T-bars); hourly capacity 94,000 persons as given (high for 21 lifts — confirm). character: A glacier ski area at the head of the Tux valley, a side valley of the Zillertal, reaching 3,250 m and known for a long season from autumn into spring. Once Austria's only year-round ski area, it closed in mid-August 2026 and reopens for 2026-27 on 2 October 2026.
learning: Reference note: there are blue runs on the glacier and ski schools in Hintertux, but altitude and weather make it better for confident skiers early in the season. Confirm beginner options.
